Overview of Active Roles

A broad listing of program and project management positions has been detailed on professional platforms for the Phoenix, Arizona metropolitan area, spanning multiple industries including aerospace, technology, defense, healthcare, and infrastructure.

Employers and Specific Positions

The listings feature various technical and operational management roles from prominent companies and organizations across regional hubs such as Phoenix, Tempe, Scottsdale, Mesa, Chandler, Gilbert, Glendale, Peoria, Avondale, Surprise, and Queen Creek. Notable roles and employers include:

  • Honeywell Aerospace: Program Director (Phoenix, AZ) and Sr. Program Manager (Tempe, AZ).
  • Amazon & AWS: Sr. Technical Infrastructure Program Manager, Data Center Planning & Delivery (Phoenix, AZ); Program Manager Data Center Operations (Avondale, AZ); Sr. Program Manager, Transparency Team, TSE (Tempe, AZ); and Senior Program Manager III, Selling Partner Trust and Store Integrity (Tempe, AZ).
  • Northrop Grumman: Program Manager 3 and Program Manager 2 for the ESPAStar Product Line (Gilbert, AZ).
  • Google: Technical Program Manager III, Industrial Operations, Technical Infrastructure (Mesa, AZ).
  • Lucid Motors: Staff Technical Project Manager, Vehicle Programs and Sr. Technical Program Manager, Vehicle Closures Systems (Phoenix, AZ).
  • Axon: Senior Engineering Program Manager and Senior Technical Program Manager II (Scottsdale, AZ).
  • Other Employers: Sandvik, GWS Tool Group, Mercury Systems, FUJIFILM Electronic Materials U.S.A., Inc., Avnet, Albertsons Companies, General Dynamics Mission Systems, onsemi, Corning Incorporated, Strive Compounding Pharmacy, Renesas Electronics, Brown and Caldwell, Worley, Viasat, Healthcare Outcomes Performance Co.
